title: Claude Code Plugin Manifest Schema
description: Schema for Claude Code plugin.json manifest files

name.description: Unique plugin identifier in kebab-case (no spaces)

description.description: Brief description of the plugin's purpose

url.description: Author's website or GitHub profile URL

homepage.description: URL to plugin documentation or homepage

repository.description: URL to plugin source code repository

keywords.description: Keywords for plugin discovery and searchability

commands.description: Custom slash command file paths (relative, starting with ./) - supplements default commands/ directory

oneOf.description: Path to a single command file or directory
Array of command file or directory paths

agents.description: Custom agent file paths (relative, starting with ./) - supplements default agents/ directory

hooks.description: Event handler configuration - path to hooks file or inline config. NOTE: hooks/hooks.json is auto-discovered; only use this field for additional or non-standard hook files.

oneOf.description: Path to additional hooks configuration file (e.g., './custom-hooks.json'). Do NOT use './hooks/hooks.json' as it's auto-discovered.
Inline hooks configuration. Valid event keys: PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop, SubagentStop, SessionStart, SessionEnd, PreCompact

mcpServers.description: Model Context Protocol server configuration - path to config or inline definition

args.description: Command line arguments for the server

hookEventArray.description: Array of hook configurations for an event

matcher.description: Regex pattern to match tool names (e.g., 'Edit|Write', 'Bash'). Required for PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PermissionRequest. For Notification: 'permission_prompt', 'idle_prompt', etc. For SessionStart: 'startup', 'resume', 'clear', 'compact'. For PreCompact: 'manual', 'auto'.

hooks.description: Array of hook actions to execute

type.description: Type of hook: 'command' (execute bash script) or 'prompt' (LLM-based evaluation, mainly for Stop/SubagentStop)

command.description: For type='command': script to execute. Use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} for plugin paths, $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR for project paths.

prompt.description: For type='prompt': prompt text to send to LLM. Use $ARGUMENTS as placeholder for hook input JSON.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for this hook (default: 60 for command, 30 for prompt)
